retainedFailedAttempts.result: Missing browser source import in the production image; process exited 1 before running capacity cases, without OOM.
retainedFailedAttempts.resolution: Read independent profiles from frozen shipped release manifests, then rerun the complete 57-account container audit.

retainedFailedAttempts.result: The first staged launch check timed out while the race kept moving and the courier had launched. The read-only helper modules were imported after resuming, leaving a network-dependent observation gap.
retainedFailedAttempts.resolution: Preload observers while paused, then resume using ordinary controller input; all four scenarios pass on the same staged image. The combat harness uses the same ordering.

retainedFailedAttempts.result: The initial 120-second public race sample overlapped briefly with startup of the loading audit. It is retained without using it as the uncontended performance gate.
retainedFailedAttempts.resolution: Run a separate clean 120-second sample after both processes have completed.
